 if str(f) not in cache: cache[str(f)]=f.read_bytes()
 original=cache[str(f)]; assert hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest()==x['chunk_sha256']; assert original.splitlines(keepends=True)[x['one_based_line']-1]==b
